t: Heavy duty heat gun with LCD digital display to quickly switch the air flow and heat settings. Temperature can be controlled in 10°C increments with a maximum temperature of 650°C. Features a ceramic heating element and 4 adjustable memory settings for regularly completed tasks. Other features include stand for hands-free operation, removeable nozzle guard, ergonomic soft grip handle. Comes with 4 nozzles, scraper, and hard-shell carry case.
